name: better-riscv-support
description: RISC-V assembly highlighting, alignment-aware formatting, symbols, and navigation.

betterRiscvSupport.indentSize.description: Number of spaces before ordinary assembly instructions.

betterRiscvSupport.alignDefines.description: Align macro names and values in each #define section. Comment-only lines and up to the configured number of consecutive blank lines remain part of the same section.

betterRiscvSupport.defineNameFieldWidth.description: Minimum width of the macro-name field after #define. The default of 24 matches the bundled define-alignment style.

betterRiscvSupport.maxBlankLinesWithoutB.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines that keep #define and assembly-column alignment sections connected. A larger run starts a new section.

betterRiscvSupport.alignAssemblyColumns.description: Align instruction mnemonics, operand commas, and inline comments in each assembly section.

betterRiscvSupport.instructionOperandSpa.description: Exact spaces between the aligned instruction column and its first operand.

betterRiscvSupport.commaOperandSpacing.description: Exact spaces inserted after each operand comma. Shorter operands are padded before their comma to keep comma columns aligned.

betterRiscvSupport.commentSpacing.description: Exact spaces between the longest formatted code tail in an assembly section and an inline # or // comment.

betterRiscvSupport.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of assembly files scanned for workspace symbol navigation.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test dist/test/defineHighlighting.test.js dist/test/formatter.test.js dist/test/symbols.test.js
